declaration.evidence_label: E-MAX DEVELOPMENT (reused development data; not OOS)

dataset.binding: the E-R2 / E-R3 development binding, unchanged: tape d12ff28a98cf9cc6..., 2,152 files, 1,902 symbols, USB-HIST-V1, 480 sessions 2024-10-16..2026-09-16
dataset.universe: Trading V1.1 PIT universe, built by the same code as E-R3
dataset.prechecks: the E-R3 prechecks are re-run before any return: frozen chain, dataset binding, V1 reproduction 70,738 / 1,729, V1.1 attribution, PIT poison

hypotheses.rule: equal-rank composite: descending average ranks of premarket_rvol, return_0900_0925, position_in_premarket_range; score = sum; score ascending; tie symbol ascending

replay_method.R0: the E-R3 path unchanged (decision.seal + replay_sealed); its trades.csv and daily_returns.csv must hash to the E-R3 artifacts
replay_method.R1_R3: per session, the variant's selected symbols are passed to the unchanged E-D2..E-D5 layers (strategy_e_d6.replay.replay_session) as the candidate set; not-selected H5 candidates are recorded as NOT_SELECTED_CAPACITY rows with zero weight; the variant's priority rank is written to selection_rank
replay_method.equivalence_check: the same subset method applied with R0 must reproduce R0's session returns exactly for every scenario, before any variant is evaluated
integrity_invariants: identical universe rows and H5 candidates for every variant
every selected symbol is an H5 candidate of its session
sessions with <= 3 candidates select the same set in every variant

evaluation.metrics: app.backtest.strategy_e_d6.run.evaluate unchanged over the 480-session timeline, no-trade sessions at 0

additional.largest_winner_loser: largest and smallest single standard trade net return at COST_10BP with symbol and session

evaluation.paired: delta_t = candidate COST_10BP session return - R0 session return for all 480 sessions (no-trade sessions included as 0); IID session bootstrap via metrics.bootstrap_mean_ci, 10,000 replicates, seed 20260921; report mean, CI and P(delta <= 0)

eligibility.integrity: PASS (prechecks, invariants, equivalence, two identical runs)

winner.pool: R1..R3 passing every eligibility and improvement condition
winner.rule: highest COST_10BP CAGR; exact ties by higher session mean, then declared order R1, R2, R3
winner.no_percentage_point_tie_band: M0 declares no CAGR tie band; none is applied
winner.no_winner: E-MAX-M1 NO_USEFUL_ENHANCEMENT; R0 ordering is carried to M2

diagnostics.period_role: interpretation only; never used to choose or alter a rule
selection_delta_vs_r0: selected set changed sessions and ratio to eligible
diagnostics.blocks: E-D6 four chronological blocks per variant; reported, not a selection condition
diagnostics.interpretation_limit: almost every session where ranking can matter lies in the broad-coverage period (block 4); a winner means a preregistered ranking beat Base selection mainly there, not that a ranking alpha is validated over two years

reproducibility.required: identical result digest and byte-identical runtime artifacts
